260336826_c6916d85.text: We performed cell-type-specific ex vivo slice electrophysiological recordings of vCA1/vSub D1 and D2 pyramidal neurons identified in the same transgenic mouse lines used above (Fig. 5f). In current-clamp mode, robust yet reversible hyperpolarization was observed in D2 neurons after application of either dopamine itself or of the D2 agonist quinpirole (Fig. 5g,h). However, neither dopamine nor the D1 agonist SKF81297 caused depolarization of D1 neurons at the concentrations tested (Fig. 5g,h), suggesting more subtle excitatory effects of dopamine on this cell type.
